notes: Budget: 8 of 8 searches used, 14 fetches. Most PA shows came from listing sites (treasurehunter.show, thecardshopfinder.com) that I may not fetch, so they are leads with no organizer page, and budget ran out before I could check them. Near-term follow-ups, in order: Philly Non-Sports (recorded, Oct 24 to 25, organizer confirmed), Mifflin County Reedsville (Oct 25), York White Rose / York Expo Center (Oct 31 to Nov 1, venue page undated), Keystone Warminster (Nov 7), Plymouth Meeting Mall (Nov 13 to 14), Conway Fire Hall (Nov 14), Coins Cards & Chaos (Nov 14 or 15), Holiday Hot Stove (Dec 12 to 13, organizer not found), Harrisburg and Denver PA (Dec 19). Year handling: the Pittsburgh Card Show homepage prints weekday and date without a year, and I added 2026 because the weekdays match 2026, the footer reads Copyright 2026, and the organizer's dealer page gives years for its other dates. Please verify the Oct 30 to Nov 1 2026 edition before publishing; confidence is medium. The Pittsburgh Card Show dealer page gives a 2027 venue conflict (June 25 to 27) and is a lead only. The Philly Non-Sports organizer page prints a phone number, which I did not record. The Monroeville Mall Nov 1 listing may be the known Treasure Cup Monroeville show, which was not checked.
